## Checklist
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` and `ruff check src tests scripts repro` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; untrusted-input paths have a hardening test
- [ ] Any changed published number is regenerated by a script and committed under `results/`
- [ ] No dataset, capture with real host data, or file over 1 MB is added
- [ ] Files listed in `scripts/freeze_v03.json` change only as part of a new, labelled rule/loader version, never for cosmetic edits (CI's `freeze-record` job checks the rule logic against the freeze)
